# Smoke-test PDFs: sources and licences

All arXiv papers below were checked on their arXiv abstract page (https://arxiv.org/abs/<id>) on 2026-10-14; each shows the CC BY 4.0 licence link. The scan is a US federal government work (public domain). Feature columns come from our own checks (text extraction plus looking at rendered pages); "not seen" means we did not find it in the pages we looked at, not that it is certainly absent.
